name: tight-70s-api
description: Tight/dry/punchy 1970s drum bus from the UAD API Vision Channel Strip (uaudio_api_vision_channel_strip.vst3) alone — the forward American-console counterpart to the Neve/Studer tight-70s chain. Won a measured 3-variant EQ shootout: highest crest (28.1), highest correlation (0.975, tight), smallest centroid rise (+244, neutral top = no hi-mid harshness). The punch is the API 225 comp (crest 25.0 -> 28.1); 215 HPF @50 Hz tightens sub; 550 EQ adds low thump + cleans box; NO top boost (that's what kept it un-harsh). Feed it a measured-balanced, dry bus (room out, snare gated, OH de-hatted). Built 2026-05-31.
intended_for: a dry, measured-balanced drum bus (bus_70s_balanced.wav) — the API strip supplies tighten + punch + 70s console color in one box
notes: Punch is from the 225 SLOW attack (transients pass before the comp grabs → crest RISES). Keep the 550 top flat: boosting hmf 5k / hf re-introduces the 2-5 kHz harshness (see v1/v3 in the shootout, centroid +535/+714). For more snap without harshness, raise 225 ratio or lower thresh, don't EQ the top. 225 'Old (FB)' = the smoother feedback topology.
